Create a pronunciation dictionary: up to 100 rules, each a word, how to say it
and the kind that value is written in: ipa, arpa or respell. Give the rules
with --rule word=value (repeatable) or --file, a JSON array of
{"word": ..., "kind": ..., "value": ...}; a rule in the file may also set
"case_sensitive": true. --kind is the kind of every --rule, and of a rule in
the file that names none. Each create makes a new dictionary, also with a name
you already use. Use the dictionary with
plivo tts speak --pronunciation-dictionary <pronunciation_dictionary_id>.

Usage:
  plivo tts pronunciation-dictionaries create [flags]

Examples:
  plivo tts pronunciation-dictionaries create --name brands --kind respell --rule "Plivo=PLEE-voh"

Flags:
      --file string        JSON file: an array of {"word": ..., "kind": ..., "value": ...}
  -h, --help               help for create
      --kind string        how a value is written: ipa, arpa or respell (required for --rule)
      --name string        dictionary name, up to 100 characters (required)
      --rule stringArray   a rule as word=value, written in --kind (repeatable)

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            preview requests and local changes without sending or writing anything
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json|jsonl|yaml|csv (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
      --query string       JMESPath filter on the JSON output, e.g. 'data.objects[].call_uuid' (implies -o json)
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --schema             describe the command (arguments, flags, output fields) instead of running it
      --show-secrets       show auth tokens and passwords in API responses instead of [REDACTED]
      --timeout duration   request timeout: seconds, or a duration such as 90s or 2m (default 30s)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
